message.content:
**Answer:**  
The most iconic sculpture of the 19th century is generally considered to be **“The Thinker” by Auguste Rodin**. Although the first bronze casts appeared in 1902, Rodin conceived the figure in the 1880s, making it a product of the late‑19th‑century artistic milieu. Its powerful pose and psychological depth made it a defining image of modern sculpture and earned it worldwide fame.  

(If you prefer a strictly 19th‑century cast, Rodin’s “Burghers of Calais” (1885‑1889) is another landmark work that remains highly celebrated.)
